english: I have a favor to ask.
Could you spare us a little of your time?
We'd like you to walk around this area.
Haah, around here... is that okay...
//fade to black after line; time passes
I'm doing what I was told,\nbut what's supposed to happen?
Again!? Alone I'm at a disadvantage~!\nTime to run~.
Why!? They cut me off!?\nI'll run back to where everyone was~.
Fuu, it seems that's the end of it.
Um, everyone... what are you talking about...
It was practice hitting moving targets.
So, we're terribly sorry,\nbut we used you as bait.
We figured they'd come out\nif a girl was alone.
We decided to leave the bait role\nto someone whose movements are unnatural to begin with...
You lured them splendidly -\nthe enemies were reeling too.
Thanks to you, it was good practice!
S-somehow, I can't just be happy about that!
